meta.name: BuzzFeed Celeb
meta.description:
From the latest celebrity headlines to favorite
hilariously mundane happenings, BuzzFeed is here to
keep you updated on what all your favorite celebs
are up to.

Shows: Snoop Dogg & Sydney Sweeney Play With Puppies, Movie & TV Castmates Play Who's Who, SpongeBob & How To Train Your Dragon Cast Talk Behind the Scenes, SpongeBob & Avatar Cast Talk Iconic Roles, Sarah Paulson & Sydney Sweeney Play With Puppies
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
